parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The number of workflows that you want to query. Valid values: 1-999. Default value: 60.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The name of the event to start the query. You can obtain the value from the response data.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun fnf get-execution-history --flow-name my_flow_name --execution-name my_exec_name --next-token flow_xxx --limit 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun fnf GetExecutionHistory --region cn-hangzhou --ExecutionName my_exec_name --NextToken flow_xxx --FlowName my_flow_name --Limit 1
